title: Requests
description: Say what you need and how much: sellers in your province quote their prices, and the cheapest comes first.

notBuyer.title: Market administrations don't send requests
notBuyer.text: Purchase requests are sent by entrepreneurs. Your account is for watching market prices and reports; they are in your cabinet.

form.title: New request
form.hint: The request goes to sellers of this product in your province.
form.limit: You can have at most {max} open requests at a time. Close one or wait for one to end.
form.maxPriceHint: Sellers see how much you are ready to pay.
form.notePlaceholder: E.g. variety, delivery, when you need it
form.noteHint: Sellers do not see your name or contact.

validation.quantity: The quantity must be above 0 and at most 10,000,000.
validation.maxPrice: The price must be between 50 and 50,000,000 UZS.
validation.noteMax: The note must be at most {max} characters.
validation.days: The time to answer must be from {min} to {max} days.

sent.title: {count, plural, one {Request sent to # seller} other {Request sent to # sellers}}
sent.text: Offers show up here and in the Telegram bot as they arrive, the cheapest first.
sent.noneTitle: No active sellers in your province yet
sent.noneText: The request stays open: sellers who list this product before the deadline will see it.

list.title: My requests
list.emptyText: Send your first request with the form above.

detail.missingText: This request was removed or belongs to another account.
detail.chosenToast: Offer chosen. Waiting for the seller to confirm.

empty.openText: Offers appear here as sellers quote. The Telegram bot tells you too.
empty.closedText: Nobody quoted on this request. Try again with another quantity or deadline.

closeDialog.title: Close this request?
closeDialog.text: Sellers will no longer be able to quote or confirm chosen offers.
